data.name: Summit Clouds Rest
data.description: Conquer Clouds Rest, Yosemite’s most rewarding summit. On this private, guided day hike, you’ll marvel at an endless panorama of peaks and jaw-dropping views. You’ll earn bragging rights and photos of a summit most people would never dare to reach!

meeting_point.address: Sunrise Lakes Trailhead Yosemite, CA US 93541

data.cancellation_notes:
Policy: Full payment due at booking

Cancel 30+ days → full refund minus platform & CC fees

Cancel 7–29 days → 50% refund minus fees

Cancel 0–6 days → no refund

Trips are never canceled due to weather
data.booking_notes:
**Packing List:**
• Sun Hat
• Sunglasses
• Water Bottle (3L per person)
• Sunscreen
• Bug spray
• Raincoat & Warm Layer

**Optional:**
•  Cash, to tip your guide!

*We will provide backpacks, trekking poles, water filter, snacks and lunch!*
